title: Facebook Rejected Him. Then Paid $19 Billion. #shorts
description:
In two thousand nine Facebook turned Brian Acton down for a job. Five years later it bought WhatsApp, the app he built with Jan Koum, for nineteen billion dollars.
Follow for more fortunes made and lost.
hook_text:
REJECTED BY FACEBOOK
THEN PAID $19 BILLION
first_comment: Would you sell your app for nineteen billion, or keep it and try to build the next Facebook? 👇

lines.text: Facebook rejected him. Five years later, it paid him billions.
How does a job rejection turn into a fortune?
In two thousand nine, Facebook turned Brian Acton down for a job.
So he joined his friend Jan Koum on a tiny messaging app.
No ads, no games, just messages. It was called WhatsApp.
Five years later, it had four hundred fifty million users.
Then Facebook came back, with nineteen billion dollars.
Koum signed it outside the welfare office where he once got food stamps.
The company that rejected Acton made him a billionaire.
Follow for more fortunes made and lost.
